rationale: lendzy.co.uk has three tool pages that serve HTTP 200 to every visitor and are recorded in pages as never built (build_status='needs_rebuild', deployed_at IS NULL). Both readings are correct: the artefact deployed on 2026-08-02 is still in the bucket, while the record was never advanced. Root cause, read at the deciding arm: each page carries a SINGLE page_components row (written 2026-08-02 by the original shadow build) with component_id NULL and slot_name 'section'. resolveComponent (rerender_page_sections_action.go:361) resolves a section by component_id first and slot_name second; the id is empty (COALESCE at :924) and no content_components row is named, functioned or typed 'section' (verified 0 rows), so the slot enters UnresolvedSlots, rerenderResolution.fatal() (:650) fails the step, the page never reaches build_status='deployed', and UpdatePageStatusAction (v3_site_actions.go:1082) only stamps deployed_at inside that branch. It cannot self-heal: needs_rebuild re-selects the page, the render fails identically, and six page_rerender items since 2026-08-25 all read complete. The unstamped rows then fail datahelpers.NeverDeployedPagePredicate, which drops the three URLs from the sitemap (27 <loc> against 30 active pages) and files 47 unbuilt_internal_link items at needs_human_review — none of which is a broken link; every target serves 200. The owner's instruction is to keep working tools, so this repairs by ADOPTION, not regeneration: create_tool_component builds from LLM-generated HTML and would replace three working calculators. Instead the live stored HTML is promoted to html_template, which is lossless because all three bodies contain zero '{{' bindings — the measurement that licenses the approach, and Guard 3 re-asserts it at apply time rather than trusting it. Filed to the 090 loop before assertion per the 2026-07-31 owner ruling: intake 1ff4c475, run 89a84ad3.

plan.summary: One migration (693). Three DO/RAISE guards, then one INSERT creating a tool component per page from that page's own live rendered_html, then one UPDATE repointing page_components (component_id + slot_name), then a DO/RAISE verify block. No Go changes. The shape of the new rows is copied from the six healthy sibling tool components on the same site, measured 2026-09-02, except created_from='adopted' rather than the siblings' 'generated' because these rows are adopted from live HTML and the column exists to record that.
plan.risks: (1) Function collision: idx_cc_tool_function_unique is UNIQUE on function where component_level='tool' AND forked_from IS NULL AND is_active, and RFC_036 9.3 says a row colliding with a LIBRARY tool must be born a FORK. Zero such rows today; Guard 1 aborts rather than assuming that holds at apply time. (2) Racing another session's repair: Guard 2 requires exactly 3 rows still at component_id NULL, so a repair landed by anyone else aborts this migration instead of overwriting it. (3) Lossy adoption: only true if the stored bodies gained template bindings between writing and applying; Guard 3 aborts on any '{{'. (4) The repair changes what the tool pages render FROM, so the real risk is silently swapping a working calculator. Acceptance is therefore at the artefact: the three URLs must still serve 200 with unchanged <input> counts (3 / 1 / 2, measured 2026-09-02 pre-repair), not merely reach build_status='deployed'. (5) needs_rebuild has no consumer on this estate, so the migration alone will not drive the rebuild; page_rerender items must be filed afterwards. That is stated as follow-up work, not assumed to happen. (6) Verification is DO/RAISE throughout, never bare SELECTs — a SELECT-only verify block cannot stop the COMMIT because ON_ERROR_STOP ignores a non-empty result set.

edits.rationale: The change. Guards 1-3 assert the three preconditions (no library-tool function collision; exactly 3 rows still unrepaired; zero template bindings in the bodies being adopted), each as DO/RAISE so a violated precondition aborts. The INSERT creates one tool component per page from that page's own pc.rendered_html, joined to a VALUES list supplying display_name and description. The UPDATE repoints component_id and corrects slot_name from the generic 'section' to the tool function, which is the shape the six healthy siblings carry and which makes the slot_name fallback route resolve as well as the id route. The verify block re-runs the lane's founding query fleet-wide, so it fails if ANY active page anywhere is left with no identified component on any row.
edits.sketch:
DO $$ ... IF n <> 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '693 ABORT: % library tool row(s) already claim one of these functions — this migration must fork, not insert (RFC_036 9.3)', n; END IF; END $$;
INSERT INTO content_components (name, display_name, description, html_template, function,
    section_type, component_level, category, render_mode, created_from, is_active,
    forked_from, suitable_site_types, suitable_page_types)
SELECT p.name || '-lendzy-co-uk', d.display_name, d.description, pc.rendered_html, p.name,
       NULL, 'tool', 'interactive', 'template', 'adopted', true, NULL, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb
  FROM pages p JOIN page_components pc ON pc.page_id = p.id
  JOIN (VALUES ('tool-price-cap-checker', 'Price cap checker', '...'), ...) AS d(page_name, display_name, description)
    ON d.page_name = p.name
 WHERE p.site_id = '8ff093d5-...' AND pc.component_id IS NULL;
UPDATE page_components pc SET component_id = cc.id, slot_name = p.name, updated_at = NOW()
  FROM pages p, content_components cc
 WHERE pc.page_id = p.id AND cc.function = p.name AND pc.component_id IS NULL ...;

edits.rationale: Restores component_id NULL / slot_name 'section' and deletes the three adopted rows, with its own DO/RAISE verify. Its header states plainly that rolling back RESTORES THE DEFECT, and warns that if the framework has already stamped deployed_at and shipped new bytes, a blind rollback leaves the record pointing at nothing while a newer artefact serves — worse than either side — with the query to check that first.

grounded_in: rerender_page_sections_action.go:361-394 resolveComponent — 'if s.componentID != "" { if ci, ok := byID[s.componentID]; ok { return ci, false, true } ... } if ci, ok := schemas[s.slotName]; ok { return ci, false, true } return componentInfo{}, false, false' — both routes fail for a row with a NULL id and a slot_name matching no component.

rerender_page_sections_action.go:650 — 'func (r rerenderResolution) fatal() bool { return len(r.UnresolvedSlots) > 0 || len(r.InvalidTemplateSlots) > 0 }', and :600 returns an error on fatal(), so the step fails rather than completing.
v3_site_actions.go:1082 — buildPageDeployStampQuery is called only inside 'if newStatus == "deployed"', so a page that never reaches that status can never be stamped.
render_sitemap_action.go:144 — 'AND deployed_at IS NOT NULL', which is why the three unstamped URLs are absent from a sitemap that carries 27 <loc> against 30 active pages [MEASURED 2026-09-02].

datahelpers NeverDeployedPagePredicateFor — 'deployed_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(build_status,'') <> 'deployed'' — one definition consumed by both the sitemap filter and the unbuilt-link check, which is why one unstamped row produces both symptoms.

[MEASURED 2026-09-02] Fleet-wide query 'HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE pc.component_id IS NOT NULL) = 0' over active pages returns exactly lendzy's three tool pages, all needs_rebuild and unstamped, and nothing else in the estate.

[MEASURED 2026-09-02] The narrower predicate 'pc.component_id IS NULL' returns 16 rows across 7 sites and 10 pages, of which only lendzy's three are stuck — so the discriminator is EVERY row on the page, not ANY, and the wrong predicate would have misdirected this fix.

[MEASURED 2026-09-02] The three stored bodies contain 0 occurrences of '{{' and their <input> counts (3 / 1 / 2) equal the served pages' counts, so the stored row is what is live and promoting it to html_template binds nothing.
[MEASURED 2026-09-02] content_components has 0 rows whose function or section_type matches these three tools, so no library row is being shadowed and Guard 1 is currently satisfiable.

Sibling shape measured on the same site 2026-09-02: tool-rollover-limit-checker-lendzy-co-uk carries component_level='tool', section_type NULL, forked_from NULL, is_active, render_mode='template', category='interactive', created_from='generated'.
chk_created_from_valid permits 'adopted' (CHECK created_from = ANY (ARRAY['manual','generated','adopted','tool','forked'])), so recording provenance honestly costs nothing.

Owner instruction 2026-09-02: 'We want to keep the tools if they're working and add them where necessary' — the licence for adoption over create_tool_component, whose header says it 'Creates a new tool component from LLM-generated HTML'.
